name: rightmove
description: Multi-server Rightmove monitor with drawn-area URLs, per-server filters, safe reconciliation, persistent scheduling, reliable embeds, and price-ordered property channels.
author: Five
install_msg: This cog queries Rightmove. After loading it, use `[p]rm setup #anchor <full Rightmove search URL>`. The anchor channel must be outside categories. Drawn-area polygons and all filters contained in the URL are preserved.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server configuration, Rightmove property metadata, Discord channel/message IDs, and scrape state. It does not store end-user personal data.
